'''Maulkiller''' was a [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Maulkiller was created by combining [[DNA/Legends|genetic material]] from<ref name="gamestop preorder" /> the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galen Marek]]. The resulting individual had [[Color/Legends|gold]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and his skin was silver with black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]. Disparate differences between the two samples caused physical and mental instabilities that led to the clone's destruction not too long after its creation. Maulkiller struck fear into all who faced him, including [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader himself.<ref name="gamestop preorder" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tattooedanddangerous.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Concept art by [[Amy Beth Christenson]]]]
Maulkiller appeared in [[2010]] as a [[Wikipedia:GameStop|GameStop]] exclusive bonus preorder avatar for players of the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''. The preorder bonus also came with "[[Maulkiller's lightsabers|Maulkiller Silver Saber]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Crystals]]," which used less Force Energy.<ref name="gamestop preorder" /> The article [[The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog: The Art of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|''The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog'']] in [[Star Wars Insider 121|''Star Wars Insider'' 121]] revealed that Maulkiller came about when team members on the project were brainstorming ideas for combat [[Clothing/Legends|wardrobes]], and that the character was inspired by Darth Maul.<ref name="Good,Bad,Gorog">{{InsiderCite|121|The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog: The Art of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog: The Art of ''Star Wars'': The Force Unleashed II}}</ref>
